EX-99.1 2 pressreleaseex991q32026.htm EX-99.1 Document Arcutis Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update • Continued strong ZORYVE® (roflumilast) net product revenue growth, with Q3 revenues of $143.9 million, +45% versus Q3 of 2025, and +11% versus Q2 of 2026, driven by strong demand growth • Raised 2026 full-year net product sales guidance to $535 million–$545 million • Partnered with World Champion gymnast Simone Biles to launch the Skin to Believe In awareness campaign for individuals living with inflammatory skin conditions • Remains on track to disclose topline results from Phase 2 trial of ZORYVE foam 0.3% in individuals with vitiligo and decision on program advancement in Q4 of 2026 • Maintained positive operating cash flow for the quarter with $18.9 million of net cash provided by operating activities Westlake Village, CA, November 4, 2026 – Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc.

• The FDA has set a target action date of February 23, 2027, for the supplemental New Drug Application to expand the indication for ZORYVE cream 0.05% for mild to moderate atopic dermatitis to infants aged 3 to 24 months.

• The Company remains on track to disclose topline results from the Phase 2 proof-of-concept study of ZORYVE foam 0.3% for the treatment of vitiligo and share its decision on program advancement by the end of 2026.
